_comment: Valérian's music (the Hellfire Gaol's third gate, ZealotBoss.cpp), played by our own sound engine as music: the
game's own music silent meanwhile. Each track played once from its phase's start: the fight is timed on it (p1: a
pulse a second from 1.37 s; p2: 92.3 BPM from 1.39 s; plan: .agents/plans/gaol-third), and the server silences it
as it ends - the engine would loop it (loopStart 0) past the track's own fade-out, never reached.
